name: phpstorm
description: Drive PhpStorm's MCP server as a first-class agent surface — code navigation, call hierarchy, inspections, and a live Xdebug debugger loop (breakpoints, frames, expression evaluation, state mutation) against local or Dockerised PHP. /phpstorm:setup-xdebug and scripts/xdebug-doctor.sh diagnose the wiring behind that loop, reading the project's services from a committed .xdebug-doctor.json.
